scope: Bounded source-only preparation runner review; accepted transaction mechanics preserved; no whole-build acceptance

checks.requirement: Independently fixed complete input authority and exact file/page sets
checks.finding: Required paths are derived from currently present data/views/index; absent top paths can disappear from validator authority. Caller rel_paths can supply a subset. Extra detection covers component Markdown only. The ordinary clone branch does explicitly reject missing declared top paths and components directory, a narrower source-level guard.
checks.correction: Require independently declared mandatory paths and page IDs, enforce the exact expected set, and reject all in-scope missing/extra paths before hash comparison.

checks.finding: SHA256 and byte length comparisons exist for supplied files. The only negative preparation control removes one Markdown page. Isolation helper compares only the first 20 production paths and writes a new probe; it is not required by this runtime proof. No full production hash-set isolation proof or missing/extra/corrupt control inventory is evidenced.
checks.correction: Retain full original path/hash sets before and after an isolated edit of an existing canonical/page file, and require separate missing, extra, corruption, and isolation controls.

checks.requirement: Actual interrupting overall deadline covering imports/read/copy/hash/reconcile/proof
checks.finding: The deadline only checks elapsed time before/after synchronous work and cannot interrupt a blocked import, read, hash, or walk. Main helper tests/imports precede its timer; post-clone manifests and negative copy work lack an interrupting deadline. Fixed cleanup budgets can extend beyond remaining time.
checks.correction: Supervise the entire preparation worker in a captured process group with a parent deadline, including import/read/hash/reconcile/proof and bounded cleanup. Prove blocked operations are interrupted in that actual path.

checks.requirement: Terminate before bounded drain, exited-leader child cleanup, truthful enumeration status
checks.finding: Timeout source orders group termination before drain and enumeration distinguishes errors/timeout from empty groups. However text stream.read(4096) can block beyond the drain deadline. Normal run_bounded does not inspect surviving descendants, and normal npm build equates a reaped leader with a clean group. Final cleanup enumeration precedes final reaping; clone callers only require exit/timeout, not verified cleanup.
checks.correction: Use nonblocking bounded reads, cleanup/check captured groups even after leader exit, fresh final enumeration after reaping, and require known empty-group/reaped outcomes. Enumeration error must remain unknown.

checks.requirement: Fail-closed runtime helper assertions and independently meaningful controls
checks.finding: The canary-free check includes an unconditional or True. Hanging-child deadline-fired is literal True and the leader also sleeps, so it does not cover an exited leader. A nonexistent process group is used as an enumeration-error test instead of forcing an error. helper_ok omits hanging-child result, reaping/group cleanup, actual injection, bounded-drain/order outcome, isolation, and full control inventory; checks are truthiness-based.
checks.correction: Require strict typed assertions for every required outcome from a genuinely passing baseline; force enumeration failure independently of a legitimate empty group; exercise exited-leader descendants and require injection plus redaction and benign output evidence.

checks.finding: No current receipt was present at the final source check. No preparation, helper, process test, or fixture mutation was run by this reviewer. Source configuration is not runtime verification. Owner/test liveness was parent-reported and not independently rechecked.
checks.correction: After the bounded repairs, retain an immutable source-bound receipt and complete manifests with safe typed scalar outcomes for all required controls.

minimal_next_action: Correct fixed input authority, interrupting parent deadline, bounded drain/group cleanup, and strict helper acceptance; then obtain immutable runtime evidence. No owner interruption or implementation changes made.
